title: IBM Db2 Genius Hub 1.1.2, 1.1.3, 1.1.4, 1.1.5 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to bypass security…
description: IBM Db2 Genius Hub versions 1.1.2 through 1.1.5 have a vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to bypass security restrictions due to the absence of a Content Security Policy header. This issue has a low severity rating and does not impact system integrity or availability.
